summary: Staff metrics cover web views, newsletter opens and clicks, and membership counts without a new analytics cookie.
detailed_changes: Record article and page views server-side with optional signed-in account linkage and no IP storage.
Add signed open and click tokens on campaign mail for first-party newsletter metrics.
Add a staff Metrics dashboard for web, newsletter, and subscription summaries, and update the cookie notice.
affected_areas: User groups affected: staff; signed-in members (reading activity); newsletter recipients
Public impact: cookie notice discloses first-party view and mail tracking
Internal impact: staff can review engagement and test-mode MRR without third-party analytics
